jobs.description:
Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:

• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:

• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:

• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines
• Processing and assembling wooden components
• Performing quality checks on finished products
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)
• Is not afraid of physical work
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality.

Jobomschrijving

This position is ideal for candidates seeking stable daytime employment in a production environment. Previous experience with wood or woodworking is not required, as all necessary training will be provided.

Responsibilities

Candidate Profile

• Physically fit and able to carry out heavy manual tasks
• Reliable, punctual, and committed to attendance
• Motivated to learn and follow quality standards
• Previous woodworking experience is not required
• You can communicate in Dutch, or English, or French
Knowledge of wood products is not necessary, and quality control tasks can be learned on the job.

The most important qualities for this role are reliability, punctuality, and consistency. Please note that the work is highly repetitive and physically demanding, making it most suitable for candidates who enjoy routine production tasks and can maintain focus throughout the day.

Our client is an international company active in a highly technical environment, serving professionals across the industrial sector. They are looking for a Customer Service & Technical Support Specialist to join their customer-facing operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As the primary point of contact for customers, you will ensure a smooth process from enquiry to order completion. You will work closely with customers, sales colleagues, and internal departments to provide accurate information, prepare quotations, and coordinate orders.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer requests and provide high-quality service throughout the sales process.
• Prepare and follow up on quotations based on customer requirements.
• Gather and verify technical and commercial information related to projects and orders.
• Coordinate with sales teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely processing.
• Maintain accurate information in internal systems.
• Create or review basic technical drawings when required.
• Monitor order data and identify discrepancies, stock issues, or missing information.
• Contribute to continuous improvements in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

• Bachelor-level education or equivalent experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, or After-Sales is required.
• Experience within a technical, engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or construction-related environment is highly desirable.
• Familiarity with technical drawing software such as CAD is considered an advantage.
• Comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems.
• Customer-focused, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a professional level of French and a good command of English.

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Verification and recording of accounts receivable data
• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures
• Preparation of invoices 
• Management of bank deposits
• Following up with clients to facilitate invoice payments
• Regular communication with clients
• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)
• Implementation of action plans to ensure the company's financial health

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an A/R Officer or in a similar role
• Trilingual proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, enabling effective communication with diverse stakeholders
• High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping
• Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations
• Proficient in Excel and SAP, with hands-on technical knowledge
• Proactive problem-solver, addressing technical challenges with practical solutions
• Solid experience in credit collection and understanding of its accounting complexities
• Valuable contributor to effective management of accounts receivables

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and follow up on B2B collection files.
• Analyze outstanding debt cases and monitor recovery procedures.
• Contact customers via phone, email, and written correspondence regarding overdue payments.
• Send payment reminders and formal notices.
• Maintain and update administrative records and internal systems.
• Coordinate with external partners, legal representatives, bailiffs, and internal departments.
• Monitor accounting statuses and liaise with the finance team.
• Prepare tailored repayment proposals.
• Ensure proper follow-up of ongoing legal and collection procedures.
• Identify risks and suggest process improvements to management.

Profile We're Looking For

• 3  years experience in credit collection and credit control
• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.
• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Good command of French; Dutch or English is a strong advantage.
• Comfortable using different IT systems and tools.

jobs.occupation: Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.
ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.
